scope: first-order scalar perturbations about a spatially homogeneous FLRW background in the frozen canonical elliptic-compensator representation
background_assumptions: delta(D^2) acting on a spatial constant H0_bar is zero
required_derivation: the second term vanishes exactly on the stated homogeneous background
for a Fourier scalar mode ell=1+k_phys^2/M_c^2, delta Q=delta H0/ell
delta J_A_total=delta Q-delta H0=-a1_eff delta H0
delta p_nu_total=delta H0-delta Q=+a1_eff delta H0
pass_rule: PASS only if the exact first-order operator algebra and Fourier reduction are reproduced without treating delta a_eff times delta H0 as a linear term.
non_claims: does not derive the final Einstein/CLASS metric equations after U1 constraint elimination
does not cover nonlinear perturbations or an inhomogeneous background
does not include massive-neutrino anisotropic stress closure
does not provide a likelihood score or choose M_c
next_if_pass: extend the standalone completion shadow interface with the certified linear projected source transfer, then derive the reduced metric-constraint mapping required by CLASS rather than modifying only the RTK fluid sound speed
